To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the EMT process is a key mechanism of cancer progression; (ii) the EMT program induces a loss of cell polarity; (iii) cell polarity is a key factor in the regulation of the EMT process; (iv) cell polarity and EMT can be linked through a common set of regulators and effectors, including the Rho GTPase family; (v) cell polarity is involved in vascular mimicry and the EMT process.
cell polarity is an essential factor for the maintenance of epithelial cells and loss of cell polarity leads to EMT and vascular mimicry.
the loss of cell polarity and its associated factors are involved in the EMT and cancer progression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms that govern epithelial polarity in cancer cells, and with the role of cell polarity in the regulation of cancer cell behaviour.
understanding the molecular mechanisms of cell polarity and the link between cell polarization, EMT and cancer.
the mechanisms by which cell polarity is maintained and the role of cell polarity in cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the loss of cell polarity and EMT are closely linked and that this loss of cell polarity in turn may be responsible for vascular mimicry in cancer.
cell polarity and EMT are closely related and the loss of cell polarity is an important step for EMT to occur and this loss of cell polarity can also be the cause of vascular mimicry in cancer cells.
EMT and vascular mimicry is a result of loss of cell polarity in cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cell polarity is a critical factor in the regulation of EMT, vascular mimicry and metastasis in cancer.
cell polarity is a critical regulator of EMT and vascular mimicry.
the cell polarity is an important factor that regulates EMT and that loss of cell polarity may be one of the mechanisms for vascular mimicry in cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EMT occurring cells are able to mimic blood vessels and this is a result of the loss of cell polarity and the acquisition of a new polarity in the direction of blood vessel formation.
cell polarity is a dynamic process which can be altered by several factors and is linked to EMT.
cell polarity is an important factor in maintaining the normal cellular physiology and its disruption can lead to EMT and vascular mimicry.
